question: How many days a week do headquarters employees have to be in the office?

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Office days
results.text: Employees assigned to the headquarters office must work on site at least 2 days per week. Each team chooses its office days.

results.title: Expense Policy

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Security while remote
results.text: When working outside the office, employees must follow the IT Security Policy, including the VPN rule for public Wi-Fi.

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Core hours
results.text: All employees must be available between 10:00 and 15:00 in their local time zone on working days.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Home-office equipment
results.text: Home-office equipment up to $300 per year is reimbursable for full-time employees. This includes chairs, desks and monitors.
